description: Upload and release H5 games on TapTap using the official TapTap CLI. Keeps your existing engine and web preview.
longDescription: Discover and upload web builds, edit store text and project images, preview the store page, bind H5 packages to drafts and inspect version history in the TapTap panel. Uses the separately installed official taptap-cli and your developer account. Review and release stay explicit agent workflows. TapTap Maker remains a separate plugin.
example.1: Upload this web game's latest build to TapTap without submitting review.
example.2: Prepare this H5 game's TapTap store page and submit it for review.
config.cliPath.description: Leave blank to use taptap-cli on PATH. On Windows, select the CLI executable (.exe), not an npm .cmd wrapper.
